qualificationScope: FY2025 consolidated non-tangible ordinary parent-attributable accounting book for draft P/B/RI research; not distributable cash, TCE, regulatory capital or formal admission
rationale: NCI is explicitly separate in consolidation policy. All reported parent issued shares are ordinary. Other equity is traced to subsidiary reserve/retained-earnings reclassifications, not assumed to be preferred instruments. The full parent component sum equals group equity minus NCI. Include reported parent reserve in ordinary accounting book, without claiming free distribution.
TCEBlocker: Group intangibles/goodwill and NCI allocation/common deductions not qualified; no automatic subtraction.
